ConsentGranted.description: A consent receipt was issued. After this event (and while not revoked and inside window), the composer may serve personalized instances for the granted classes.

ConsentRevoked.description: A consent receipt was revoked. No NEW personalized instances may be composed after this event; already-anchored impressions stay factual.

description: Consent as decision-core domain events, not a UI checkbox. ConsentGranted/ConsentRevoked flow through the same invariant machinery as playback events: without a valid, unrevoked, in-window grant covering the required classes, the composer serves fallback only (INVARIANT P2). Envelope-compatible with xr-event.schema.json (event_id = idempotency key per I6).
